name: KingdomCraft-S13
description:
Kingdomcraft SMP is a Kingdoms Server, we have created our own User Interface so server moderation with staff is not really a requirement.

The User Interface lets players do the following:

Create Player plots.

Create and manage Kingdoms.

Create kingdom plots, based on mined blocks.

Create and manage Teleport locations.

Create and manage Shop plots.

Manage what level of storage is protected on your plots.

The base protection on Kingdomcraft is to a level normally only ever seen on Java Edition.

In the event that a player does actually mange to get around the Protection (no one has yet) we have Backups and options to repair the damaged areas.
